name: puppetnet-web
description: Build and test tooling for the PuppetNET graph intelligence console (web/) and the edge relay (worker.js). No runtime dependencies: the browser assets in web/vendor/ are committed, so the console deploys to Cloudflare Pages with no build step.

scripts.check: node --check worker.js && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/modals.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:worker && npm run test:web

//: playwright is deliberately NOT a devDependency: its postinstall downloads browser binaries on every `npm ci`. The screenshots workflow installs it with --no-save, and `npm run screenshots` prints the one-line local install if it is missing.
